briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.1% and S&P 500 -0.2%, showing no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($89.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new buys were made despite 3 open slots. Existing 7 positions are held unchanged, letting automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules manage exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors avoid adding new positions because market signals are unclear or weak, preferring to protect capital rather than chase uncertain gains. Today's neutral market and limited cash reinforced a wait-and-see approach rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指在市場訊號不明朗時，投資者選擇不增加新持倉，寧願保留資金也不冒然進場。今日大市走勢中性，加上可用現金有限，因此採取觀望策略，不勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%. There was no dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a market in a holding pattern awaiting fresh economic or earnings data. Low volatility sessions like this often precede a more decisive directional move once new information arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，納斯達克指數微跌0.1%，標普500指數跌0.2%，缺乏明確的主導消息刺激。市場似乎在等待新的經濟數據或企業盈利消息，暫時處於觀望狀態。這種低波動的交易日往往是市場醞釀下一步方向的前奏。
